run_preprocess_i2b2_2014_ner_cli: run the CLI to preprocess i2b2 2014 NER XML files into CONLL format for train dev and test splits
read_xml_file: read an i2b2 XML file and extract character-level text and BIO entity labels from tagged spans
merge_into_words: merge character-level text and labels into word-level sequences for NER tokenization
reprocess_phi_labels: reprocess PHI and entity labels from XML folders into train and dev CONLL text splits
main: run the full preprocessing pipeline to generate train dev and test CONLL files from i2b2 XML directories
